Green and Purple Mineral Specimen on Matrix
Large rough mineral specimen featuring translucent green and purple crystalline material with white matrix and reddish-orange surface staining.

278047782.description:
Radical Scientific Equipments
Advanced Rock & Mineral Collection
36-Piece Geological Specimen Set
9" x 9" x 2"
Educational Geology Kit
This professional-grade geological collection features 36 distinct rock and mineral specimens curated for educational study and identification. Produced by Radical Scientific Equipments, the set encompasses a broad spectrum of earth materials including igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rocks alongside diverse mineral samples. From the metallic luster of galena and graphite to the crystalline structures of rose quartz and geodes, this collection serves as an essential reference for students and earth science enthusiasts.
Specimens are housed in a clear protective tray with individual compartments
Includes a comprehensive identification key matching specimens to their numbers
Features a diverse range of materials including sulfur, obsidian, and azurite
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The identification sheet is clean and fully legible. The specimens remain well-preserved within their original sorting tray. The outer cardboard box displays minor edge wear and light scuffing consistent with careful storage and handling.

277710387.description: This vintage lot includes drafting and engineering tools from manufacturers like Dietzgen and Staedtler. The set features multiple compasses, dividers, and precision drafting instruments housed in original velvet-lined and leather cases, along with a Staedtler Marsmatic 700 technical pen set complete with a case and ink bottle. Several vintage slide rules, including a Dietzgen model, are included, as well as a 1965 desk calendar, metal and wooden rulers, and various small paper and metal desk accessories. Most items show signs of age and use, including some wear on cases and paper, but remain in collectible and functional condition.

278073065.description:
2 Vintage La Rocca Italian Champagne Smoking Pipes Briar Wood
This listing includes two vintage Italian smoking pipes by La Rocca. The first pipe is marked 'La Rocca Speciale 963 Italy' and features a classic bent billiard shape with a smooth, light brown briar wood bowl and a metallic bronze acrylic stem. The second pipe is marked 'La Rocca Champagne Italy' and has a bent shape with a glossy, medium brown briar wood bowl and a swirled reddish-brown and cream acrylic stem. Both pipes are used and show signs of darkening and residue inside the bowls, along with minor surface scuffs and wear consistent with age. These pipes are collectible examples of Italian pipe craftsmanship.
